messages:
Jordan (AE): Heads up — CoinStrike RFP landed. They sent a 60+ question security questionnaire and want a capability matrix + POC plan by EOD tomorrow. I uploaded a draft matrix here: https://drive.redwood/example/coinstrike-draft. Can SE/product/infra weigh in on gaps?
Mira V (SE): On it. Quick notes after a skim: HSM integration question unclear (they asked for 'hardware key isolation' + required FIPS). Also they want example throughput for embeddings at 8k context.
Alex P (Product): For throughput numbers we should give ranges and call out configuration assumptions. Suggested lines: "Hosted (shared) — 70-150 rps embeddings (8k ctx) typical; Dedicated — 400-700 rps; Private — depends on GPU count". Put a note about concurrency and batching.
Samir K (Infra): Important: Private + BYO-HSM is possible but takes an ops window. We can support KMIP + HSM in Private; Hosted only supports cloud KMS (no hardware HSM export). Also peering note: cross-account VPC peering needs customer's infra team to open peering and route tables — that's a blocker if they want immediate PoC.
Jordan (AE): Good call. CoinStrike listed 'on-prem HSM' as a must for compliance. Priya — can legal sign off on a BYO-HSM clause and timeline for certs?
Priya L (Legal): We can accept BYO-HSM in Private deployments with SLA caveats. Need DPA + SOC2 attestation copy and explicit data residency clause. Ask them to confirm the regions and retention window.
Mira V (SE): I'll update the matrix. Also their RFP asks about fallback model variants and rollout policies (can we show our canary A/B + fallback?). Quick snippet I propose adding to capabilities: "Automatic model fallback to quantized variant when latency spike or capacity shortage detected".
Alex P (Product): Approved. Add recommended quantization profiles for 13B/70B models and a short note on expected quality delta: ~2-4% BLEU-ish for typical tasks (wording: small QA/regression risk).
Samir K (Infra): Scheduling note for POC: Private test deploy (BYO-HSM) requires 2-week lead to provision and validate HSM certs. Dedicated reserved pool can be spun in ~3 business days for limited capacity. Hosted PoC (no HSM) can start next business day.
Jordan (AE): That's the tradeoff we need to surface in reply. I'll frame options: fast hosted POC vs secure private BYO-HSM with 2-week lead.
Mira V (SE): Matrix draft — adding CSV snip in thread for quick copy-paste:```
feature,hosted,dedicated,private
SLA,none (usage tier),99.9% (reserved),99.95% (enterprise private)
HSM,KMS-only (cloud),KMS + optional HSM (dedicated infra),KMS + BYO-HSM (onboarding)
Throughput (embeddings rps, 8k ctx),70-150,400-700,custom (depends on GPUs)
Region controls,limited,regional clusters,customer-controlled
Audit logs,standard,extended,full (on-prem audit export)
Rollouts,model pinning,canary + A/B,canary + BYO fallback
```
Jordan (AE): Perfect — can you paste that into the RFP doc and mark the HSM rows as conditional?
Mira V (SE): Done. I added conditional language and an attachment link back in the Drive: https://drive.redwood/example/coinstrike-final-matrix.
Priya L (Legal): Also attached: standard DPA and a checklist of docs we need from them: SOC2 report, HSM vendor certs, region confirmations.
OpsBot: Deployment note: created ticket INF-8123 for Private HSM onboarding. ETA TBD once vendor certs received.
Samir K (Infra): One more technical blocker to call out: customer uses strict egress restrictions. For Private we require management plane access to our control plane for rollouts — if they can't allow that, we'll need an air-gapped package and longer lead time.
Jordan (AE): Good capture. Final ask: can SE/Infra confirm the quick-response packaged answers I should send to procurement? I want to reply to RFP with 3 options (Hosted quick PoC, Dedicated reserved pool, Private BYO-HSM) + explicit timelines/caveats.
Mira V (SE): Yes. I'll add timelines + bullet caveats and push back to Drive in 30m.
Alex P (Product): I'll add a short pricing bracket for each option (hosted per-token estimate, dedicated monthly commit example, private licensing + deployment fee).
Priya L (Legal): I'll draft the BYO-HSM clause and conditions.
Jordan (AE): Thanks all. If no surprises, I'll send a consolidated RFP response by 17:00 PST. :thumbsup: 
Mira V (SE): :eyes: ping me before sending, will scan for technical accuracy.
Jordan (AE): Will do — thanks everyone.
